title: chore(ci): lower client lint warning ceiling 6971 -> 6967
intent: Lock the client ESLint warning ceiling to the count measured on current main (34 errors, 6967 warnings, 1486 files). The ceiling stayed at 6971 after the count fell, so four new warnings could land without failing the gate. Kept out of the dependency PRs per the standing ruling that a dependency bump must not move a lint ceiling. Governance-only: no source, lint rule, ignore, dependency, or lockfile change.
behavior_change: CI only. The lint ratchet fails above 6967 warnings instead of above 6971, and still fails above 34 errors. Baseline regenerated with --write-baseline from two identical lint:report runs of origin/main 8692f1b4. Compared with the previous baseline, four values differ: total_warnings 6971 -> 6967; files_linted 1484 -> 1486; warnings_by_rule @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any 960 -> 957; warnings_by_rule max-lines-per-function 138 -> 137. The per-rule warning counts sum to 6967 and the per-rule error counts sum to 34. total_errors, errors_by_rule, errors_by_file, every other warnings_by_rule entry, and _comment are unchanged. A focused test pins the 6967/6968 and 34/35 boundaries, the committed baseline's rule-count sums, and the existing client_lint_build.yml path filters. core_ci.yml names that test because nothing collects scripts/ci wholesale. The four-warning reduction is not from this patch. Full lint diffs attribute it to #481 (6971 -> 6968, three max-lines-per-function warnings that left with the deleted February 19 risk composables) and #482 (6968 -> 6967 net: no-explicit-any 960 -> 957 and max-lines-per-function 135 -> 137). #493 (eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0 -> 10.12.1) and #494 (konva 10.9.0 -> 10.9.1) change zero lint messages.

diff_articulation.what_changed: client_lint_baseline.json: total_warnings 6971 -> 6967, files_linted 1484 -> 1486, no-explicit-any 960 -> 957, max-lines-per-function 138 -> 137. New scripts/ci/test_client_lint_ratchet.py. core_ci.yml gains one pytest step for that test. This manifest.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without the lower ceiling the ratchet still tolerates four warnings of unnoticed regression. A ratchet only ratchets if the ceiling follows the measured count down. The test is what fails an inconsistent rule-count sum; the checker itself compares only the two totals.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: Error ceiling 34 and its breakdowns. The type-check ceiling (87). client_lint_build.yml (both pull_request and push path filters already list the baseline and the ratchet script). No client source, no ESLint config or ignore, no dependency, no lockfile, no generated artifact. The checker script is not rewritten. SPRINTS.md is unchanged; completed ratchet orders are not an index that file requires.

commands_run: Branch cursor/client-lint-warning-ceiling-6967-6965 from origin/main 8692f1b4 (merge of #494). Both #493 merge 61beca87 and #494 merge 8692f1b4 are ancestors. gh/open-PR search: no open pull request.

packages/client: npm ci (Node v22.23.4). npm run lint:report twice. Normalized (severity, rule, path, line, column, message) tuples identical: 1486 files, 34 errors, 6967 warnings, 7001 messages. Per-rule warning counts (20 rules) sum to 6967. Per-rule and per-file error counts sum to 34.
check_client_lint_ratchet.py --report run1 --write-baseline and the same for run2 produced byte-identical baselines. Key diff versus the previous baseline is the four values named above.

Lint diff, same command, clean npm ci at each commit. eb24a99c (#480 merge, ceiling on main): 1487 files, 34 errors, 6971 warnings. 158dde45 (#481): 1483 files, 6968 warnings, only max-lines-per-function 138 -> 135. cfaf0775 (#482): 1485 files, 6967 warnings, no-explicit-any 960 -> 957 and max-lines-per-function 135 -> 137. 53a86f0b (#492), 99a58807 (eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0), 61beca87 (#493, plugin 10.12.1), and 8692f1b4 (#494) are message-identical to each other at 1486 files / 34 / 6967. #493 did not produce the reduction.

File set versus the #480 merge lint: six paths disappeared because #481 deleted the files (RiskDashboardCrossLabV2.vue, riskDashboardLegacy.spec.ts, composables/index.ts, useRiskBuckets.ts, useRiskExport.ts, useRiskFilters.ts). Five paths appeared (RosetteComparePanel.spec.ts, useRosetteCompareApi.spec.ts, RiskDashboardCrossLab.spec.ts, riskDashboardRequestOrder.spec.ts, useAuthStore.signOut.test.ts). 1487 - 6 + 5 = 1486. No surviving file left the lint set. .eslintrc.cjs is unchanged. The recorded 1484 was the pre-merge measurement; the three test files already on main at eb24a99c (riskDashboardLegacy.spec.ts, riskDashboardDecomposed.spec.ts, riskDashboardFixtures.ts) contribute 0 warnings, which is why 1487 files still totaled 6971.
Real report against the new baseline: PASS (warnings 6967, ceiling 6967). One injected warning: FAIL warnings rose 6967 -> 6968 (+1). One injected error: FAIL errors rose 34 -> 35 (+1).

services/api/.venv/bin/python -m pytest scripts/ci/test_client_lint_ratchet.py -q: 15 passed. Covers 6967 pass, 6968 fail, error 35 fail, missing/malformed/empty/zero-file inputs fail closed, committed rule-count sums, inconsistent sum rejected, reduced file count printed and not a totals failure, and both workflow path filters.
npm test (vitest run): 57 files passed, 1 skipped; 891 tests passed, 17 todo.

npm run type-check on the default Node heap aborted (exit 134, ~2GB old-space OOM). Same command with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 exited 2 and check_client_type_check_ratchet.py reported vue-tsc errors 87, ceiling 87, PASS. No client source changed, so this is the existing ceiling.
